purpose: Prove the certification gate is mechanically trustworthy in BOTH directions before relying on it to separate implementation from evidence commits.
method: Run the gate against two real commit pairs from this repository: one documentation-only pair that MUST certify, and one pair containing a real compiled-source change that MUST NOT certify.

results.case: positive-control (docs-only pair, certification MUST carry forward)
results.what_changed_between_them: docs/agent/WORKSTATE.md and two evidence markdown files only

results.case: negative-control (compiled source changed, certification MUST NOT carry forward)
results.what_changed_between_them: tests/engine/bench_first_generation_publish.cpp (a derived translation unit compiled into ffengine_bench_first_generation_publish)
results.attribution_note: The gate named precisely the one file that differs, with no false positives and no missed differences.

defect_found_and_fixed_during_validation.severity: high (a false PASS in a certification gate)
defect_found_and_fixed_during_validation.what: The first implementation hashed only the executable-impacting PATH SET, not file content. Two revisions with the same file layout therefore always produced an identical digest.
defect_found_and_fixed_during_validation.how_it_was_caught: Adversarial negative test. The negative control (3323fcb -> 69d1b61) reported PASS despite a real 12-line change to a compiled translation unit.
defect_found_and_fixed_during_validation.fix: The digest now hashes '<path>\0<git blob object id>'. A blob id is a content hash, so any content change under an unchanged path moves the digest. A new pathsWithChangedContent field reports the differing files explicitly.
defect_found_and_fixed_during_validation.post_fix_behaviour: Negative control FAILS with exit code 1 and names the exact changed file; positive control still PASSES with exit code 0.
defect_found_and_fixed_during_validation.lesson: A certification gate that has only been shown to pass is not a certification gate. The negative control is what makes this result trustworthy.

why_this_matters: The campaign brief (section 10) requires that a certification record can describe a certified binary without pretending the evidence commit itself was rebuilt. That is only sound if the equality check is capable of failing. It now demonstrably is.
